cards.name: Wilt-Leaf Liege
cards.oracle_text:
({G/W} can be paid with either {G} or {W}.)
Other green creatures you control get +1/+1.
Other white creatures you control get +1/+1.
If a spell or ability an opponent controls causes you to discard this card, put it onto the battlefield instead of putting it into your graveyard.

rulings.comment: If a spell or ability an opponent controls causes you to discard Wilt-Leaf Liege, and both Wilt-Leaf Liege's ability and another ability (such as that of an opponent's Leyline of the Void) instruct you to put Wilt-Leaf Liege somewhere else instead of putting it into your graveyard, you choose which one to apply.
If you discard Wilt-Leaf Liege and put it onto the battlefield, you've still discarded it. Abilities that trigger when you discard a card will still trigger.
Wilt-Leaf Liege's first two abilities are separate and cumulative. If another creature you control is both of the listed colors, it will get a total of +2/+2.
